brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres, dampers, and the airflow path around Ivybridge Gate 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-818) to clear any obstruction exceeding one quarter of the free area before the heat event, as outlined in SOP-015. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure in accordance with MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period pursuant to MG-021.
